capabilities: env is mandatory and explicit; store, db and runReadOnlySql are mandatory injected capabilities; no process.env or default client fallback is permitted.

lifecycle.parser: Exact original URL and POST only; no case/trailing/query aliases. No-store. Exact application/json UTF-8 or absent/identity content-encoding; preserve raw bytes; reject invalid JSON, oversize and early stream abort before dependencies.
lifecycle.write: Capture, then exactly one existing recordAuthenticatedPrivateCustodyExchange call; core performs one fixed readback and never retries an ambiguous write.
lifecycle.query: Capture, then existing readAuthenticatedPrivateCustodyExchange; NO_MATCHING_ORIGINAL_WRITE_READBACK remains unresolved and is not success custody.
lifecycle.cleanup: closeAuthenticatedPrivateCustodyExchangeCapture in every capture exit; request listeners and parser-owned buffers are released/zeroed and raw/parsed request body references deleted; pre-abort, request abort and response close are observed; close after complete end is not treated as abort.
lifecycle.response: Success is {ok:true,data:<existing core DTO>}; failure is bounded {ok:false,error,state} with no raw body, credential, receipt, operation id or ACK fabrication.

main_insertion_proposal.index: After makeRestoreMutationGate and before the existing route registrations, import the registrar and call it with explicit env, createSupabaseDeviceCredentialStore(supabaseAdmin), db:supabaseAdmin, the existing fixed runReadOnlySql, and optional clock.
main_insertion_proposal.parser: Add only /device-auth/private-custody to the exact-path exemption in request-json-parser.js so the registrar owns the untouched request stream. Do not disable the general parser or broaden other exemptions.
main_insertion_proposal.main_source_registration: src/index.js calls the registrar only with explicit configured capabilities behind the unchanged restore gate; unconfigured custody fails 503, never a default writer. This source connection is not deployment or current-auth HTTP/SQL success.

scope_limits: No SQL, auth, grants, credentials, production, browser, device, build, install, release or audit actions.
Local tests use synthetic injected capabilities and do not establish hosted SQL, native APK or runtime proof.
